name: separate-object
title: Separate an object from its neighbour
description: Push an object straight away from its closest neighbour until there is room for a finger (>= 3.5 cm gap) without leaving the support.
use_when: Two objects are too close for the fingers to fit beside one of them.

not_to_be_confused_with.push: separate pushes until a finger fits beside the object.

preconditions.name: hand_empty
preconditions.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

preconditions.name: base_near
preconditions.meaning: Base centre within 1.3 m of the place's footprint (inside the room for a room).
preconditions.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

preconditions.name: grasp_clearance
preconditions.meaning: Some annotated pinch of the object has both finger slots (2.8 x 1.2 cm, at the pre-grasp opening) free of neighbours; objects without a pinch need 3.5 cm of free footprint gap.
preconditions.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

postconditions.name: grasp_clearance
postconditions.meaning: Some annotated pinch of the object has both finger slots (2.8 x 1.2 cm, at the pre-grasp opening) free of neighbours; objects without a pinch need 3.5 cm of free footprint gap.
postconditions.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

verifier.how: after the policy chain, every listed predicate is evaluated on ground-truth simulator state (object poses, joint values, finger gaps, head-camera geometry, thermal state, event log); the node succeeds only if all hold for the selected path

checks.name: grasp_clearance
checks.meaning: Some annotated pinch of the object has both finger slots (2.8 x 1.2 cm, at the pre-grasp opening) free of neighbours; objects without a pinch need 3.5 cm of free footprint gap.
checks.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

fallback_for.when: fingers have no room beside the object (grasp_clearance false)

failure.on_failure: stop; return every measured predicate, the completed policy steps and the fallback skills whose repaired predicate failed; the planner chooses what to do. Inside a multi-object node a nested call that fails a precondition with a matching repair fallback runs that repair once and retries.
